start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya interesting lagta hai?

turns.line: samajh nahi aaya, ek example se samjhao
turns.reply: Jaise garden ki boundary 5 m, 3 m, 5 m, 3 m ho, perimeter ke liye sab sides jodiye: 16 m. Aap kitna jodenge?
Koi baat nahi, Kabir. Perimeter matlab boundary ki total length: 5 plus 3 plus 5 plus 3, yani 16 m. Ab pehli do sides jodiye.

turns.board: Rani runs 3 rounds of a rectangular park 50 m long and 30 m wide. How far does she run?
turns.reply: Pehli do sides: 5 plus 3 equals 8. Ab bachi do sides, 5 aur 3, jodkar bataiye.
